title: Screen MCP tool calls and results for jailbreaks (Beta)
body: You can now screen MCP tool calls and their results in Unity Gateway for jailbreak and prompt injection attempts. Apply the **Jailbreak** guardrail on input, output, or both. See [Attach a built-in policy](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/service-policies/create-service-policy#use-a-built-in-policy).
